about: Edition of the Harbour Privacy Circle, a fictional monthly meetup in a port city. Kept in its own folder so the base edition.json stays intact. Build with: python3 build.py --edition examples/harbour-circle/edition.json --out dist-harbour --serve. Every key is explained in docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

book.title: A Guide to Autonomy
intro: A learning book for everyone about personal and digital autonomy: keeping your conversations and accounts private, choosing the tools you depend on, and holding your own money, including Bitcoin.
Each chapter starts from a concrete need, explains why a tool helps and where it falls short, then walks you through the steps, with sources close to the passages they support.

start_paths.title: Protect my accounts
start_paths.text: Passwords and account security first, then your email and your aliases.

start_paths.title: Protect my conversations and my browsing
start_paths.text: Your messengers, then your browser and your searches, then your network.

start_paths.title: Control my data and my devices
start_paths.text: Alternatives to Big Tech services, the settings of your phone, then hosting your own services.

start_paths.title: Understand Bitcoin
start_paths.text: Savings, a first wallet, backing up the seed phrase, everyday payments, privacy, hardware wallets and your own node.
